Article 16, first paragraph: the ordinary rate of 22 %, in force from 1 October 2013; it applies to electricity that is not for domestic use nor for the uses table A, part III, number 103 lists (extractive, agricultural and manufacturing enterprises, which this pack does not tell apart). The common parts of a condominium (a coproperty) bear it too, as the tax agency's answer 142 of 3 March 2021 reads number 103, unless the condominium is made of dwellings alone whose electricity serves domestic uses, which the segment does not say

Table A, part III, number 103: 10 % on electricity for domestic use, a supply to a final customer using it in its dwelling or in a similar collective residence, a person or a household; the row is loaded from the day the ordinary rate became 22 %, the reduced rate being older

The incentive of the decree 414/2023 is paid only on the energy shared by plants and consumption points connected under the same primary substation (cabina primaria); the energy may be shared within one market zone (Decreto legislativo 199/2021, article 31, as amended by the decree-law 19/2025, article 1-bis), which no criterion of the model holds: the perimeter loaded is the one of the shared energy the incentive and the TIAD value. The primary substation is a grid.substations row, the meter says which one it is downstream of, read on the energy services manager's maps
